gripOrHq.title: Emergency Rig
gripOrHq.rulesText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put X Kludge counters on that piece of ice; X cannot be 0. At the start of each of your turns, remove a Kludge counter. Trash that piece of ice when the last Kludge counter is removed from it.

gripOrHq.title: Emergency Rig
gripOrHq.rulesText: Rez a piece of ice, at no cost. Put X Kludge counters on that piece of ice; X cannot be 0. At the start of each of your turns, remove a Kludge counter. Trash that piece of ice when the last Kludge counter is removed from it.

gripOrHq.title: Data Fort Reclamation
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [10] and choose up to four cards stored in HQ when you score Data Fort Reclamation. Create a new data fort using the cards chosen. Install the cards one at a time; you may rez them when you install them. Then, return to the bank any of the [10] not spent.

gripOrHq.title: Colonel Failure
gripOrHq.rulesText: *Trash a program. *Trash a program. *Trash a program. *End the run. *End the run.

gripOrHq.title: Snowbank
gripOrHq.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Snowbank.

heapOrArchives.title: Puzzle
heapOrArchives.rulesText: *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Puzzle
heapOrArchives.rulesText: *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Executive Boot Camp
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Discard a card at random: Gain [2]. Use this ability only during a run. At the end of the run, return to the bank any of the [2] you did not spend.

heapOrArchives.title: Syd Meyer Superstores
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A: Trash a rezzed piece of ice. Gain [4].

heapOrArchives.title: Dr. Dreff
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever the Runner passes the last piece of ice on this fort or declares a run on it when it has no ice, you may choose an ice card stored in HQ. Pay half of that card's rez cost, rounded down, to force Runner to encounter it; the run is not considered successful unless Runner passes that piece of ice. Trash that ice after the encounter ends. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

heapOrArchives.title: Corporate Shuffle
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: Short-Term Contract
discardCards.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

discardCards.title: The Short Circuit
discardCards.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

discardCards.title: The Short Circuit
discardCards.rulesText: A, [1]: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Reshuffle your stack afterwards.

discardCards.title: Evil Twin
discardCards.rulesText:
[3]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.
Prevents up to 2 net and/or brain damage total each turn.

discardCards.title: Gideon’s Pawnshop
discardCards.rulesText: Search your trash for a card and bring it into your hand.

discardCards.title: If You Want It Done Right...
discardCards.rulesText: Look through the top five cards of your stack. Bring one of those cards into your hand, and arrange the rest in any order you choose.

discardCards.title: Succubus
discardCards.rulesText: Succubus can host up to 3 MU of programs. If Succubus leaves play, trash all hosted programs.

scoreArea.title: Security Purge
scoreArea.rulesText: Show the top three cards of R&D to Runner when you score Security Purge. If any of those cards are ice, install and rez them, at no cost. Trash the rest of those cards.

rig.title: Pile Driver
rig.rulesText: [3]: Break up to four wall subroutines on a single piece of ice. [1]: +1 strength. Whenever you use Pile Driver’s break-walls subroutine, lose a total of [3] from stealth cards.

rig.title: Skivviss
rig.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Skivviss counter. Each Skivviss counter requires the Corp to draw one extra card at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rig.title: Afreet
rig.rulesText: Afreet can host up to 3 MU of programs. Hosted programs use Afreet's hosting capacity instead of Runner MU. All icebreakers hosted on Afreet have their strength reduced by 1. If Afreet leaves play, trash all programs hosted on it.

rig.title: Skivviss
rig.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Skivviss counter. Each Skivviss counter requires the Corp to draw one extra card at the start of each of its turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

rig.title: Shield
rig.rulesText: Prevents up to 2 Net damage each turn.

rig.title: “Drifter” Mobile Environment
rig.rulesText: Put [2] from the bank on Mobile Environment when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for removing tags. If you use any of these bits, replace them from the bank at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.
